androidx.appcompat.widget.AppCompatTextV.android:text:
Thank you for downloading Mermaid Plugin!

Tap the button to open the editor: type Mermaid code (or pick a template from the toolbar) and the diagram renders below. Select diagram code in your note first to edit it here.

Image: renders on your device with bundled mermaid.js and saves a PNG into your note. Nothing leaves the device.

Link: inserts a mermaid.ink image link, so the diagram text is sent to that server. Long-press the button with text selected for this quick option.

Code: inserts the diagram as a mermaid code block.
